newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Prop in HK$628 mln rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Allied Prop in HK$628 mln rights plan.

text.p: Property group Allied Properties (H.K.) Ltd said on Wednesday it proposed to raise about HK$628 million before expenses by way of a rights issue of 483.41 million new shares.
The company said it proposed to distribute the rights shares in the proportion of one rights share for every five existing shares held at an issue price of HK$1.30 each.

Of the net proceeds of HK$620 million after expenses, HK$320 million would be used to reduce debt, with the remaining balance for developing property sites on Java Road in North Point and Jaffe Road in Wanchai on Hong Kong Island, it said.

"Taking into account the available banking facilities and internal resources of the company and the expected net proceeds of the rights issue, the company has sufficient working capital for its present requirements," Allied Properties said.
The company said its controlling shareholder Allied Group Ltd, which holds 1.21 billion company shares, had undertaken to accept in full the rights shares allotted to it.
Allied Group had also undertaken to apply for an additional 35 million rights shares or 1.21 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, the statement said.
On completion, Allied Group's stake in Allied Properties will be increased to about 51.45 percent from 50.25 percent.
The register of members will be closed from April 3 to 7.
Trading in shares of Allied Properties resumed on Wednesday after a one-day suspension. Its shares fell HK$0.11 to HK$1.34 in late Wednesday morning.
